verdict.rationale: There is no documented one-click or CSV export. The evidence suggests subscribers can be pulled programmatically: the subscribers API filters by tags, segment, and creation/update/last-event/unsubscribe dates, and the CLI and MCP can search and look up subscribers. A founder could likely script a contact-and-tag extraction, but only with developer effort. Missing for 10: an explicit self-serve audience export in an open format (CSV/JSON), documented export of custom fields and engagement/event history, explicit suppression-list export, and independent or hands-on confirmation of a full-audience export.
